title: QCDIAG: additional cmd implementations
description:
Additional commands implemented:
- Version Information (0x00)
- Mobile Station Electronic Serial Number (ESN) (0x01)
- Bad Command (0x13)
- Bad Parameters (0x14)
- Bad Length (0x15)
- Bad Mode (0x18)
- Markov Statistics Reset (0x1b)
- Timestamp (0x1d)
- Log On Demand (0x78)
- DIAG Loopback Test (0x7b)
- Extended Build ID (0x7c)

Minor updates on qcdiag_cmds[] value_string.

Correcting one ett_qcdiag_xxx name.

Coverity Scan is down due to maintenance (upgrades) so I could not verify the code change there.

Example pcap: [qcdiag.pcapng](/uploads/a41c4a1e5ede18a3f7e603f592b86bee/qcdiag.pcapng)

Additional participants: @laf0rge, @osmith42, @lynxis
